subject: Package room access log shows unauthorized entry
description:
Reviewing the package room access logs for this week, I found several entries at odd hours (2:00 AM - 4:00 AM) that don't correspond to any resident or delivery personnel. The door was opened using a code that should have been deactivated last month.

Suspicious entries:
- May 14, 2:13 AM — Code 7842 (deactivated Apr 30)
- May 15, 3:47 AM — Code 7842
- May 16, 2:55 AM — Code 7842

No packages were reported missing, but this is a serious security concern.

messages.author: Lisa Wong
messages.body: I'm very concerned about these late-night entries. The code 7842 was issued to a contractor who completed work in April. It should have been removed from the system on April 30th.

messages.author: Sarah Chen
messages.body: Lisa, I've reviewed the logs and confirmed the issue. The code deletion didn't propagate to the door controller due to a sync error. I've manually deactivated the code on the controller and initiated a full sync. I'm also reviewing all other deactivated codes to ensure they've been properly removed.

messages.author: Sarah Chen
messages.body: I recommend changing the package room door code entirely and notifying residents of the new code via the app. I've prepared the update — pending your approval to proceed.

messages.author: Lisa Wong
messages.body: Agreed. Please proceed with the code change and resident notification. Let's set the new code and distribute it through the app announcement feature.
